title: Research Radar Evidence Packet Schema v1
description: Schema for evidence packets produced by Research Radar from internet sources. Compatible with lane evidence exchange protocol.

packet_id.description: Unique identifier for this evidence packet (UUID v4 or ULID)

source.description: Origin system from which the item was retrieved

url.description: Permanent URL to the original source item

author.description: Author name(s) as string or array of strings

published_at.description: Public ISO 8601 timestamp when the source item was published

license.description: SPDX license identifier or URL; null if unknown or ineligible

raw_text.description: Full extracted text content from the source (may be truncated for size)

summary.description: AI-generated concise summary of the source content (1-3 sentences)

claims.description: Key assertions, findings, or claims extracted from the source

code_links.description: URLs pointing to code repositories, gists, or code snippets

paper_links.description: URLs to related academic papers, preprints, or citations

confidence.description: Model confidence in relevance assessment (0.0 to 1.0)

relevance_score.description: Computed relevance to project focus areas (0.0 to 1.0)

risk_level.description: Estimated risk of implementing changes based on this evidence

proposed_action.description: Description of experiment, test, or system change suggested by this packet

provenance.description: Chain of custody and processing metadata for this packet

retrieved_at.description: Timestamp when the source was fetched

source_checksum.description: SHA-256 hash of the original source content (raw feed or API response)

processing_version.description: Version of the Research Radar processing pipeline that created this packet

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent or connector that produced this packet

verified.description: Whether this packet has been manually reviewed and approved

verified_by.description: Agent or human identifier who verified this packet

processing_notes.description: Optional diagnostic or transformation notes from processing
